available_modalities: URL strings, 46 extracted URL & webpage content features
usage_restrictions: Open research and commercial use with attribution
label_generation_methodology: Automated extraction & verification via active crawler and security heuristics
data_collection_methodology: Phishing collected from open feeds; legitimate from Alexa/Tranco top domains
available_timestamps: No per-sample crawling timestamp in CSV; temporal window is 2023-2024

recommended_research_role: Primary training candidate for lexical and structural models

dataset_name: Phishing and Legitimate Websites Dataset V2.0

dataset_name: PhreshPhish: A Large-Scale Phishing Website Dataset
available_modalities: URL strings, Raw HTML documents, benchmark split metadata
file_size: 36.6 GB (full repository), 52.8 MB (downloaded sample shard test-000)
usage_restrictions: Strictly for anti-phishing research; redistribution restrictions apply
label_generation_methodology: Multi-engine threat intelligence verification and automated sandboxed browser harvesting
data_collection_methodology: High-throughput crawler capturing full HTTP response DOM and network headers
available_timestamps: Granular crawl timestamps provided per sample (2025-09-08 to 2025-12-16)
screenshot_and_html_availability: Full raw HTML included; no rendered screenshots
known_limitations: Full repository is 36.6 GB requiring bounded sampling; bounded sample provides 1,000 verified DOMs
potential_data_leakage: Benchmark splits provide strict temporal separation to mitigate temporal leakage
recommended_research_role: Multimodal HTML DOM structure analysis and external asset leakage detection
decision_rationale: Provides authentic, uncompressed raw HTML DOM trees for script, iframe, and form analysis; bounded streaming satisfies our 35 GB storage reserve.

publishers_authors: Rachana S. Potpelwar, Uday V. Kulkarni, Jaishri M. Waghmare
available_modalities: URL strings, 18 lexical and structural features
usage_restrictions: Open research and commercial use with attribution

recommended_research_role: Independent evaluation candidate to test out-of-distribution generalisation

publishers_authors: Rami Mohammad, Fadi Thabtah, Lee McCluskey
label_generation_methodology: Rule-based automated feature extraction from live pages in 2012-2014
data_collection_methodology: PhishTank, MillerSmiles, and Google search queries

potential_data_leakage: Extreme overlap with academic papers; prone to overfitted heuristics
recommended_research_role: Historical benchmark and sanity check baseline
decision_rationale: Classical baseline widely cited in phishing literature; valuable for regression testing and reproducing early feature baselines.

publishers_authors: Neda Abdelhamid, A. Ayesh, Fadi Thabtah

data_collection_methodology: Custom PHP crawler querying target endpoints
screenshot_and_html_availability: Features derived from forms and popups; no raw assets

recommended_research_role: Sanity test for minimal rule-based associative classifiers
decision_rationale: Compact reference dataset for unit testing rule-mining and associative classification models.

usage_restrictions: Free for non-commercial and academic research; requires attribution; redistribution prohibited

available_modalities: URL strings, target brand metadata, submission & verification timestamps

recommended_research_role: Real-time threat intelligence validation and brand targeting verification

available_modalities: URL strings, malware threat tags, registrar, IP, ASN, timestamps
usage_restrictions: Free for research and security operations; API v2 requires free registered Auth-Key

usage_restrictions: Open research and commercial use with attribution

decision_rationale: Offers pre-computed multi-space feature representations across DNS, SSL, and HTML without needing a live network crawler.
